# Getting Started

> Start testing your MCP server in minutes

> [!NOTE]
>
> The u
pcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with u
ploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing b

ehavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector

Every option below opens the MCPJam Inspector. Pick one based on where your MCP

server runs.

> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.com)
>
> No install. HTTPS servers only. Share servers with your team.

> [c
ard] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#terminal)\n>\n> `npx @mcpjam/inspector@latest`. Requires Node.js. HTTP/S a

nd local STDIO.

> [card] [macOS](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`). No Node.js. H

TTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.exe` instal

ler). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Docker](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#docker)
>
> Pull from Doc
ker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run inside the container.\n\n* **Your server has a public HTTPS URL**: any option works.
The web app needs no install.\n* **Your server runs on `localhost` or over STDIO**: use Terminal or the macOS or Windows desktop a
pp. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Inspector isolated in a container**: use Docker. Reach servers on your machine at `h
ttp://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that STDIO commands run inside the container, not on your machine.\n\nSee [Installation
ch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you through connecting your first server. You can:\n\n* **Enter your own server
** — paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.example/mcp`) or a STDIO command (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker only).\n* **Try
the Excalidraw demo** — a hosted diagramming MCP app, no setup required.\n\nAfter connecting, MCPJam shows the server name and to

ol count, then offers an **Open Playground** button that seeds the chat with the prompt:

```
What can this server do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API key, ngrok, or ChatGPT/Claude subscription needed.
